name: classic-hollywood-valentine-portrait
image_purpose: fashion campaign and Valentine editorial portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a classic Hollywood studio portrait of one approved adult woman against a deep-crimson backdrop with a large bright ivory heart-shaped light behind her.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman standing in left-facing profile with a calm confident expression, dark hair styled in a low vintage bun with smooth waves, classic glam makeup with bold red lipstick, subtle winged eyeliner, softly contoured cheeks, luminous natural skin, multi-strand pearl choker, pearl drop earrings, and a black strapless evening gown with a sweetheart neckline, fitted silhouette, one-sided high slit, and matte or soft-satin finish.
composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 full-body or three-quarter-body framing, subject centered slightly left with elegant negative space.
Large symmetrical bright ivory heart shape aligned behind the head and upper torso with a clean soft edge glow.
Subject's hands remain placed behind her back, shoulders relaxed, chin slightly lifted.
Deep crimson background, black gown, warm skin tones, pearl jewelry, and controlled rich-red palette.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Classic studio key light from camera-left, soft fill from the right, subtle rim light separating subject from backdrop, Hollywood glamour highlights on cheekbones and shoulders, and evenly illuminated heart without banding or clipping.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 9:16 vertical portrait, 85mm lens at f/2.8, sharp face and jewelry, crisp dress edges, softened but clean heart backdrop, fine film grain, medium-high controlled contrast, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Classic Hollywood studio portrait of one approved adult woman standing in left-facing profile with hands behind her back, relaxed shoulders and chin slightly lifted. She has dark hair in a low vintage bun with smooth waves, bold red lipstick, subtle winged eyeliner, softly contoured cheeks, luminous natural skin, a multi-strand pearl choker and pearl drop earrings. She wears a black strapless evening gown with a sweetheart neckline, fitted silhouette, one-sided high slit, and matte or soft-satin finish. Use a deep crimson studio backdrop with a large bright ivory symmetrical heart-shaped light behind her head and upper torso, soft edge glow, elegant negative space, 9:16 vertical full-body or three-quarter framing, classic key from camera-left, soft fill from right, subtle rim light, Hollywood glamour highlights, controlled rich-red grading, 85mm f/2.8, fine film grain, no text, no watermark.
